text:
Predicates:
Popular(x) ::: x is a popular Netflix show.
BingeWatch(x) ::: Karen will binge-watch x.
Download(x) ::: Karen will download x.
NetflixShow(x) ::: x is a Netflix show.
Share(x, y) ::: Karen will share x with y.
Premises:
Popular(strangerThings) ::: "Stranger Things" is a popular Netflix show.
Popular(x) → BingeWatch(x) ::: If a Netflix show is popular, Karen will binge-watch it.
BingeWatch(x) ↔ Download(x) ::: If and only if Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will download it.
¬Download(blackMirror) ::: Karen does not download "Black Mirror".
NetflixShow(blackMirror) ::: "Black Mirror" is a Netflix show.
BingeWatch(x) → Share(x, lisa) ::: If Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will share it with Lisa.
Conclusion:
Share(strangerThings, lisa) ::: Karen will share "Stranger Things" with Lisa.
